editorial.blurb: The L Station brings warmth and flavor to a cozy dining space, where attentive service and well-crafted cocktails match the care put into every plate.
editorial.insiderTip: Ask your server (especially if it's Malik) for cocktail and entrée recommendations—the staff's suggestions consistently elevate the experience, and expect a wait on food but it's worth it.

topDishes.note: Coated in hot honey sauce with perfect balance of sweet heat
Crispy fried chicken and waffles with greens and yams, flavorful and comforting
Each bite is flavorful and pairs beautifully with the sides
